2607.05927.title: CMDR: Contextual Multimodal Document Retrieval
2607.05927.paper_summary: Multimodal document retrieval aims to retrieve relevant pages while preserving both textual and visual content from the original document. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate simple lexical or semantic matching, and most methods encode pages independently. Consequently, they overlook the contextual information in the document required to resolve queries that aggregate information across multiple pages. In this paper, we introduce CMDR and CMDR-Bench, a new multimodal document retrieval task and benchmark that require modeling document context. To address this challenge, we propose CMDR-Embed, a contextual multimodal embedding framework that explicitly incorporates document context by jointly encoding multiple pages and deriving page-level embeddings from a shared contextual representation. Furthermore, we introduce CMCL, a contextual multimodal contrastive learning objective that effectively trains CMDR-Embed by balancing contextual modeling with page-level discriminability. Experiments demonstrate that CMDR-Embed significantly outperforms non-contextual embeddings, highlighting the importance of context-aware multimodal embeddings for advancing document retrieval.
2607.05927.paper_summary_zh: 多模態文件檢索旨在檢索相關頁面，同時保留原始文件中的文本和視覺內容。<lb/>然而，現有的基準主要評估簡單的詞彙或語義匹配，大多數方法獨立編碼頁面。<lb/>因此，它們忽略了文件中的上下文信息，而這些信息對於解決聚合跨多個頁面的信息的查詢是必需的。<lb/>在本文中，我們介紹了CMDR和CMDR-Bench，一個新的多模態文件檢索任務和基準，這需要建模文件上下文。<lb/>為了應對這一挑戰，我們提出了CMDR-Embed，一個上下文多模態嵌入框架，通過共同編碼多個頁面並從共享的上下文表示中推導頁面級嵌入，明確地納入文件上下文。<lb/>此外，我們介紹了CMCL，一個上下文多模態對比學習目標，通過平衡上下文建模與頁面級可區分性，有效地訓練CMDR-Embed。<lb/>實驗表明，CMDR-Embed顯著優於非上下文嵌入，突顯了上下文感知多模態嵌入在推進文件檢索中的重要性。
